components.name: Button
components.description:
Triggers an action. Use `primary` for the one main action in a view,
`secondary` for alternatives, `ghost` for low-emphasis actions and
`danger` for destructive ones (pair those with an alertdialog confirm).
Press handling is React Aria's (mouse, touch, keyboard, AT unified). Use
`isLoading` rather than `isDisabled` while an action is in flight: it
keeps focus on the button and announces "Loading" without renaming it.
Inside a disabled Fieldset it disables automatically.

props.name: isLoading
props.description:
Shows a spinner and blocks activation while true, but — unlike
`isDisabled` — keeps the button focusable so keyboard/AT users don't
lose their place when an action starts. Pass it (even as `false`)
from the start on any button that can load: that renders the live
region up front, which screen readers need in order to announce it.

components.name: Dialog
components.description:

element (or the dialog) on open, and restored to the trigger on close;
the page behind is made inert to assistive tech. Escape always closes.
Usage: wrap a trigger Button and this component in `DialogTrigger`.

components.name: Fieldset
components.description:
Groups related fields under one announced label (WCAG 1.3.1).
Use it when the group label is needed to understand a field: two
"Street" inputs for shipping and billing, or sections of a long form.
Radio and checkbox options already group themselves (RadioGroup,
CheckboxGroup); use Fieldset around *different* controls that belong
together.

props.description: Disables every control inside, natively and visually.

props.description: Native fieldset `name`, included in form.elements.

props.description: "plain" (default): a titled section. "boxed": a bordered panel.

components.name: useInheritedDisabled
components.description:
Disabled if the control says so *or* any enclosing Fieldset is disabled.
The fieldset must win: a native `<fieldset disabled>` disables its
inputs regardless, so `isDisabled={false}` inside one would otherwise
look enabled but be inert. Returns the control's own value (possibly
undefined) when no fieldset is disabled, so React Aria defaults stand.
